const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const fs=require('fs');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "const subs=['SaaS','microsaas','juststart','EntrepreneurRideAlong','Entrepreneur','indiehackers','webdev'];\n",
 "const out=[];",
 "(async function(){",
 " for(const s of subs){",
 " await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,95000)});",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get('https://www.reddit.com/r/'+s+'/top/.rss?t=year');",
 " out.push('\\n########## r/'+s+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' ##########');",
 " if(r.status!==200){ continue; }",
 " const es=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
 " out.push('ENTRIES: '+es.length);",
 " for(const e of es.slice(0,8)){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const title=t?t[1].replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)):'?';",
 " let body=ct?ct[1].replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' '):'';",
 " out.push('--- '+title);",
 " out.push(body.substring(0,400));",
 " }",
 " }catch(e){ out.push('r/'+s+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs-out.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
 " }",
 " out.push('\\n=== DONE ===');",
 " fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs-out.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
 " console.log('DONE, wrote', out.length, 'lines');",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Background fetch of 7 subreddits", run_in_background: true });
console.log(JSON.stringify(r));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const fs=require('fs');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "const subs=['SaaS','microsaas','juststart','EntrepreneurRideAlong','Entrepreneur','indiehackers','webdev'];\n",
  "const out=[];",
  "(async function(){",
  "  for(const s of subs){",
  "    await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,95000)});",
  "    try{",
  "      const r=await get('https://www.reddit.com/r/'+s+'/top/.rss?t=year');",
  "      out.push('\\n########## r/'+s+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' ##########');",
  "      if(r.status!==200){ continue; }",
  "      const es=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
  "      out.push('ENTRIES: '+es.length);",
  "      for(const e of es.slice(0,8)){",
  "        const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
  "        const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
  "        const title=t?t[1].replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)):'?';",
  "        let body=ct?ct[1].replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' '):'';",
  "        out.push('--- '+title);",
  "        out.push(body.substring(0,400));",
  "      }",
  "    }catch(e){ out.push('r/'+s+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs-out.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
  "  }",
  "  out.push('\\n=== DONE ===');",
  "  fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs-out.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
  "  console.log('DONE, wrote', out.length, 'lines');",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-subs.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Background fetch of 7 subreddits", run_in_background: true });
